camel_example: aliyun sas AddSasModuleTrial --region cn-hangzhou --ModuleCode vulFix --Lang zh
description_en: Adds a trial for the value-added modules of Security Center, including vulnerability remediation and threat analysis and response
description_zh: 增加云安全中心增值模块的试用，包括漏洞修复、威胁分析与响应等模块
kebab_example: aliyun sas add-sas-module-trial --module-code vulFix --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddSasModuleTrial

parameters.help_en:
The module code. Valid values:
vulFix: vulnerability remediation
cloudSiem: threat analysis and response
parameters.help_zh:
模块code。取值：
vulFix：漏洞修复
cloudSiem：威胁分析与响应
parameters.name: module_code

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

AuthLimitList.description_en: The list of authorization quotas. This parameter is valid only when ModuleCode is set to cloudSiem. The values indicate the log storage capacity (GB) and the log ingestion traffic (GB/day) for threat analysis and response
AuthLimitList.description_zh: 授权额度列表。当ModuleCode为cloudSiem时有效，含义分别为威胁分析与响应日志存储容量（GB）和日志接入流量（GB/天）

GmtEnd.description_en: The end time of the trial

GmtStart.description_en: The start time of the trial

ModuleCode.description_en:
The module code. Valid values:
vulFix: vulnerability remediation
cloudSiem: threat analysis and response
ModuleCode.description_zh:
模块code。取值：
vulFix：漏洞修复
cloudSiem：威胁分析与响应

Status.description_en:
The trial status. Valid values:
1: in trial
0: trial ended
Status.description_zh:
试用状态。取值：
1：试用中
0：试用结束

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
